seen_animation: Frames 1-6: a large black line helicopter fills the frame, cropped on the left and bottom; the rounded nose with its cockpit window line sits at the right, a mast and a three-to-four-line rotor stand above, and two landing struts run off the bottom edge. The rotor lines change angle every frame, and in frames 2, 4, 6 one blade is drawn as two close parallel strokes. Grey clouds stay fixed at top left and top right, and a grey horizon line crosses the lower body. Frame 7: the tail boom extends further left and the body tilts nose-down, and the skid bar comes into view at the bottom. Frame 8: the upturned tail fin with its small stabilizer tick appears at the upper left, so the whole helicopter is visible. Frames 9-16: the helicopter shrinks steadily and drifts toward the centre-right, keeping the nose-down tilt, rotor still changing angle; by frame 16 it is small, around the right-centre of the frame, just above the horizon line. From frame 8 onward a grey scribbled shape sits behind and under the fuselage.
seen_film: A Huey-type military helicopter flies past close to the camera. Frames 1-5: the cabin fills the frame, nose at the right edge, rotor blurred across the top, skids visible above a 'Helicopters' caption bar; the tail boom runs off the left edge. Frames 6-8: the helicopter moves away and right, the tail boom lengthens into view and the tail fin appears at the upper left by frame 7-8, with a nose-down tilt. Frames 9-16: the whole helicopter is visible and shrinks as it flies away, settling right of centre in the upper-middle of the frame; a tree line and grass appear at the bottom from frame 11 onward.
named_subject: a helicopter (single main rotor, mast, rounded cockpit nose, long tail boom with upturned tail fin, skid landing gear)
evidence: Frames 1-5 in both: close cabin crop with nose at right and rotor on top, tail off the left edge. Frames 7-8 in both: tail boom extends and the tail fin appears at upper left (film fin at frame 7-8, animation fin at frame 8), body tilts nose-down. Frames 9-12 in both: full helicopter, fin upper left, cockpit right, shrinking. Frames 13-16 in both: small helicopter right of centre, still receding; animation frame 16 sits at about the same place as the film's frame 16. The animated body keeps the doodle's construction throughout: hooked tail with a short tick, step from boom up to cabin, diagonal cockpit line, two struts to a single skid bar, and a crossed rotor on a mast.
primary_gap: In frames 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14 one rotor blade is drawn as two near-parallel strokes, which on playback may flicker as a doubled line that neither the doodle (single strokes) nor the film has.
closes_when: Every frame draws each rotor blade as one single stroke, with the blades only changing angle between frames.
protect: The timing of the reveal (close crop frames 1-6, tail fin entering at frame 8, steady shrink frames 9-16), the final position right of centre matching the film, the consistent nose-down tilt, and the doodle's own line construction (hooked tail tick, cockpit diagonal, two struts on one skid, crossed rotor).
identity_gap: The character is the doodle's helicopter, but the grey scribble placed behind the fuselage from frame 8 onward overlaps the body and muddies its outline at small sizes (frames 13-16).
